'''2008 New York State Championship Alex Levine DS Bring Him Before Me''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Alex Levine]] at [[2008 New York State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|DS2-D-bringhimbeforeme.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS15]]
